parsed.review_summary: The candidate rationale correctly addresses all three error targets. It acknowledges that the comment references the authors' own QM datasets and FreeSolv experiments, which constitutes a unique, obvious part of the paper. It corrects the factual claim that no specific part is pinpointed. It also corrects the rubric misapplication by noting that the comment both identifies an obvious part and specifies what needs to be addressed. The rationale preserves the unrelated correct reasoning about the comment's specificity regarding MoleculeNet and OGB. No numeric score or gold label is stated. The corrected rationale is coherent and can be used for rescoring.
